canonical_project: AWS European Sovereign Cloud data center, Massen-Niederlausitz / Finsterwalde
notes: Elbe-Elster county welcomed AWS locating a central part of the European Sovereign Cloud in Massen; DataCenter-Insider reported earthworks and a container village visible at the Massen industrial park near Finsterwalde; Amazon announced EUR 7.8B for the first sovereign region in Brandenburg.
